criteria.description: The human has to walk through or past it every day.
It is something the human needs to use: a chair, a keyboard, clean clothes, a bed.
Something breakable or spillable is within paw reach.
It is most inconvenient during the human's busy hours (work, calls, deadlines).
It is enclosed on at least three sides.
The human can simply move it out of the way.
It smells like the recycling bin.
